create_random_agent: create a RandomAgent instance with a config object to generate random discrete or continuous navigation actions
run_random_agent_act: run the RandomAgent act method with an Observations object to get a random navigation action and info dict
reset_random_agent: reset the RandomAgent timestep counter to zero using the reset method
reset_random_agent_vectorized: reset the RandomAgent state for vectorized environments using the reset_vectorized method
review_random_agent_config: review the RandomAgent initialization to understand snap probability, stop probability, and max movement configuration
